Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/misinterpreted the authorship information and incorrectly stated that The Man in the High Castle was co-authored by Ray Nelson, then concluded that Ray Nelson wrote both works. This conflation of author credits led directly to the wrong solution, despite earlier web evidence showing Philip K. Dick as the sole author of The Man in the High Castle.
